items.item_text: Must obtain a Veterinary Assistant Controlled Substance Permit (VACSP) within 3 months of date of hire.
Current California Registered Veterinary Technician RVT license.
Experience in animal handling; including handling difficult or fractious patients.

Experience using Eklin, Canon, Philips machines as well as VMACS, PACS hospital information systems, Ambra imaging exchange, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, information databases, maintaining and effectively organizing records, and logbooks.
Experience with nursing skills to include but not limited to; IV catheterization, common drug sedation and dosing, sedation monitoring, surgical preparation, and aseptic techniques.

Experience instructing small groups in animal handling, radiographic techniques, small animal anatomy, radiographic, ultrasound, and fluoroscopy image quality as well as knowledge of infectious and zoonotic disease protocols in veterinary medicine.

Under general supervision of the Hobbs Medical Director, Executive Director and Radiologist provide clinical and research imaging technical support for radiology examinations, instruction of students, administrative support, and maintenance support for the Hobbs VMC Radiology/Ultrasound/Advanced Imaging Services. Working within general guidelines established by the Radiology Department, make independent judgments in terms of determining the acceptability of each patient's scan so as to preclude the recall of the patient for further radiographic examination to procure a standard of patient care.
Ability to prioritize on and scheduling case load according to the patient’s condition, study required, time restraints, surgery schedules and work force availability.

Knowledge of Radiation Laws and Guidelines required when using radiation producing equipment, radiographic techniques, patient positioning, operation of equipment to adequately obtain radiographs according to established protocols, collaborate with radiologists using correct anatomical, physiological, and radiographic terms when discussing radiographic examinations.
Interpersonal and written skills sufficient enough to work with a diverse group of people in such a manner as to build high morale and group commitments to goals and objectives.
